csv.header: first line of every chunk file; column order is the order of 'fields'; readers parse by header name (C05) and refuse unknown or missing required columns
csv.empty: the empty string is null; allowed only where required is false
csv.decimal: '.'; fixed point, no exponent; >= 3 decimals for m, m/s and m/s2, >= 6 for rad, rad/s, 1/m and unit vectors

writer.write_api: FileHandle.Write with the byte count checked (TBD-3); FileHandle.WriteLine is never used
writer.chunk: a chunk file is written whole (header + rows) by one Write, then closed; it is closed at chunk_max_rows, after chunk_max_s of world time, or at session end, whichever comes first; a chunk is written only when it holds at least one row
writer.commit: after the chunk is closed, one commit line {chunk_id, first_key, last_key, n_rows, n_bytes} is appended to <stream>/commit.csv with one open-APPEND-write-close cycle and checked; only then are the chunk's rows acknowledged
writer.heartbeat: heartbeat.csv: header when the session starts, then one row appended every 5 s with one open-APPEND-write-close cycle; never rewritten in place; readers take the last complete row
writer.on_failure: any short or failed write (chunk, commit line, heartbeat row, session.json) stops the session with end_reason script_error:write_fail; status ok is never written
writer.readers: read committed chunks only; discard uncommitted tails; C34 re-reads every committed chunk

clock.rows: frame-bound (D-A): one ctl and one telemetry row per fixed-frame callback (EOnFixedFrame applies the held command, EOnPostFixedFrame writes the rows after the covered steps); EOnSimulate / EOnPostSimulate count as callbacks of one step when the engine delivers them
clock.physics_step: the 0-based index of the last engine fixed step the callback covers, counted from the session open; physics_step of a row = physics_step of the previous row + its covered_steps; the first row has covered_steps - 1
clock.step_dt: measured in readiness: the median over frames with a fixed step of the step callback's time slice / the steps it covers (engine), when 90% of at least 30 ratios lie within 0.5% of it; else the world time between the first and last readiness frame with a step over the steps after the first (measured); never GetFixedTimeSlice() alone (session.json engine.step_dt_s)
clock.world_time: one world_time_ms per render frame (the frame clock), shared by the frame's hf row and its callback's ctl and telemetry rows
clock.logged_state: poses follow the frame clock: the pose in hf row n is the pose at the world time of frame n - 1, and step-row poses follow world time; time differences between rows are world_time_ms differences

decision.grid: due_g = anchor + g * 1000 / decision_hz ms (integer; decision_hz 5 or 10), anchor = world_time_ms of the first ctl row; the decision callback of grid point g is the first callback with world_time_ms >= due_g; a callback that reaches several grid points takes one decision and the others are counted as skipped
decision.physics_steps_per_decision: N = floor(1000 / decision_hz / step_dt_ms + 0.5): nominal steps of a decision interval and the length of action_exec
decision.decide_in: the decision callback C_t, after its ctl and telemetry rows are written, from the state of that row; P_t = its physics_step
decision.applies_in: the callbacks after C_t up to and including C_t+1: physics steps P_t + 1 .. P_t+1 (the decision interval, n_t = P_t+1 - P_t steps)
decision.bridge_pause: the closed-loop bridge (DD-8) holds the next physics step after the rows of C_t, waits until obs_t is done (done_render_frame >= the render frame of C_t + 1), sends state_t and obs_t, and applies the returned command from step P_t + 1
decision.hl_seq: -1 until the first command; +1 exactly on the row after a decision callback in which the driver gave a command; a command changes only with an increment or at an episode boundary

action_exec.row_rule: step q from the ctl row that covers it; empty past P_t+1

obs.rule: the newest image whose pose row (hf row captured_render_frame + 1) has last_physics_step <= P_t and whose captured_render_frame is at or before the render frame of C_t (obs_age_ms >= 0)
obs.max_age: one image period, from the world time of hf row captured_render_frame

joins.img_to_hf: exact: img_resolved.captured_render_frame = hf.render_frame; in Workbench 1.8 captured_render_frame = img.done_render_frame - 1 (the cross-check)
joins.hf_to_telemetry: exact: hf.last_physics_step = telemetry.physics_step (a telemetry row per callback)
joins.capture_pose: hf.cam_* and hf.veh_* of hf row captured_render_frame + 1 (the image of frame C shows the state of hf row C + 1); the pose belongs to the world time of hf row C; an image of the last render frame (seal without drain) has no pose row and is not joined
joins.frame_clock: ctl and telemetry rows of one key share render_frame and world_time_ms; ctl world_time_ms = hf world_time_ms of the same render frame; hf.last_physics_step = the newest ctl key with a smaller render_frame

image_grid.anchor: world_time_ms of the first ctl row (the anchor of the decision grid)
image_grid.due_ms: anchor + g * 1000 / image_hz - clocks.img_lead_ms for grid point g = 0, 1, 2, ...; each grid point reached while the ego is live and the camera current becomes the next slot_id
image_grid.issue: EOnFrame of the first render frame whose world time is at or past due_ms once the anchor exists (grid point 0, due at the anchor, in the frame after the first callback's); one request in flight
image_grid.resolve: the img row is written when the slot resolves (file seen: done_render_frame; timed out, skipped, refused or sealed: done_render_frame empty), in slot order
image_grid.in_flight_timeout: a request whose file is not seen within clocks.img_inflight_timeout_ms (real time) stops blocking the next slot: events kind img_timeout (payload img_slot_id=<n>) and heartbeat img_fail
image_grid.session_end: no new request; hf rows continue until no request is in flight or img_inflight_timeout_ms has passed, then the session seals; requests still unresolved count as images.pending_at_end

ctl.written_in: EOnPostFixedFrame (EOnPostSimulate when the engine delivers it)
ctl.cadence: one row per fixed-frame callback (1 to 3 physics steps on 1.8, TBD-1)

fields.name: physics_step
fields.desc: Engine fixed-step clock: the 0-based index of the last engine fixed step this callback covers, counted from the session open (the first row has covered_steps - 1); each row adds its own covered_steps (section 6). The row is written in EOnPostFixedFrame, after the covered steps.

fields.name: covered_steps
fields.desc: Engine fixed steps this callback covers, >= 1: BaseWorld.GetFixedSteps() of its render frame (1 to 3 on 1.8); 1 per call when the engine delivers EOnSimulate (section 6).

fields.name: render_frame
fields.desc: GetFrameNumber() at the callback: the render frame whose fixed steps this row covers; its EOnFrame (hf row) precedes the callback (section 6).

fields.name: world_time_ms
fields.desc: World time of the callback's render frame since the session start: WorldTimestamp.DiffMilliseconds against the session-start timestamp (R03), the frame clock of section 6. Non-decreasing.

fields.name: episode_id
fields.desc: Current episode; -1 outside an episode (warm-up, settle, between episodes).

fields.name: mode
fields.desc: Capture mode of this callback (r2 3.1): E clean expert, N noise injection, R recovery start, X exploration, D DAgger, H human, A AI ego, I idle (no HL command held: warm-up, settle).

fields.name: driver
fields.desc: Who produced the executed HL command of this step (C18, C27).

fields.name: hl_seq
fields.desc: Counter of the HL decision applied in this row's covered steps: -1 until the first command; it advances by 1 exactly on the row after a decision callback in which the driver gave a command (the decision of C_t is taken after the rows of C_t and applies from physics step P_t + 1) and stays on every other row; a command changes only with an increment or at an episode boundary (section 6, TBD-1).

fields.name: hl_kappa
fields.desc: Held HL curvature target applied in this callback's covered steps (the action_cmd.kappa_target of decision hl_seq, decided at the previous decision callback), right-positive. Empty in mode I.

fields.name: hl_accel
fields.desc: Held HL acceleration target applied in this callback (action_cmd.a_target, desired).

fields.name: hl_dir
fields.desc: Held HL direction command applied in this callback: -1 reverse, 0 stop, +1 forward.

fields.name: exp_kappa_now
fields.desc: Expert HL curvature re-evaluated on the true state after this callback (r2 3.2): a per-callback diagnostic; at a decision callback C_t it is the label of decision t, which in mode E is the command applied from P_t + 1. Empty when no expert is attached.

fields.name: exp_accel_now
fields.desc: Expert HL acceleration re-evaluated after this callback.

fields.name: exp_dir_now
fields.desc: Expert HL direction re-evaluated after this callback (added to r2's exp_{kappa,accel}_now so the label has all three action channels).

fields.name: llc_steer_raw
fields.desc: llc_v1 steering before its rate limiter and lag, engine-native sign (contract sign: multiply by session.json control.steer_sign, TBD-5). Empty when llc_v1 is not driving.

fields.name: llc_steer_lim
fields.desc: llc_v1 steering after the explicit rate limiter and first-order lag, as passed to SetSteering, engine-native sign.

fields.name: llc_throttle
fields.desc: llc_v1 throttle as passed to SetThrottle; never non-zero together with llc_brake.

fields.name: llc_brake
fields.desc: llc_v1 brake as passed to SetBreak.

fields.name: llc_handbrake
fields.desc: Handbrake flag passed to SetBreak.

fields.name: llc_gear
fields.desc: Gear index passed to SetGear (engine index; mapping in the vehicle card, TBD-7). Empty when no gear is set this step.

fields.name: llc_clutch
fields.desc: Clutch passed to SetClutch; empty unless a scripted gearbox sets it (TBD-7).

fields.name: input_pre_steer
fields.desc: GetSteering() read in EOnFixedFrame right after the setters, before the covered steps (an input readback, not a wheel angle; r2 3.2), engine-native sign.

fields.name: input_pre_throttle

collision.desc: physics_step of the callback at which the detector first crossed events.collision_dv_mps (src dv or dv_contact); for src contact the last completed physics_step when ProcessCollision reported the contact. It lies in the row's episode (episode_id) and never after the row's physics_step.

Horizontal world-frame delta-v: the peak of the norm of v_h(t) - v_ref over events.collision_peak_ms after the onset, v_ref the interpolated velocity at onset - events.collision_window_ms; >= events.collision_dv_mps unless src is contact; for src contact the vanilla momentum change of the vehicle over its mass (SCR_CollisionDamageContainer.m_fTotalMomentumOwner / Physics.GetMass).
That delta-v along the horizontal forward axis of the vehicle at the onset (local z, forward-positive: a frontal hit is negative); empty for src contact.
That delta-v along the horizontal right axis at the onset (local x, right-positive); empty for src contact.
Horizontal speed of v_ref (collision_window_ms before the onset); for src contact the speed before the contact (SCR_CollisionDamageContainer.GetOwnerVelocityBefore).
What was hit, classified in the order of section 9.5.1 from the vanilla contact (src dv_contact or contact) or from a registered vehicle with an onset within 3 steps and 10 m; unknown without either.
veh_slot_id of the other vehicle when it is a registered slot (C35).
Prefab of the other (root) entity when it is not a registered vehicle, without its {GUID} prefix.
Largest vanilla contact impulse of the matched contacts (src dv_contact or contact).
dv: the delta-v detector alone; dv_contact: the detector and a vanilla contact; contact: a vanilla contact without a detector onset (a hit below the threshold, never terminal).
